newsitem.title: SPAIN: Uralita 9-mo profit falls to 1.93 bln ptas.
newsitem.headline: Uralita 9-mo profit falls to 1.93 bln ptas.

text.p: group Uralita for the first nine months of 1996, in billions of
NOTE: Indications for the fourth quarter were so far positive, the company said, with PVC prices improving following an increase in demand which the company expects to continue in the coming months.

The company attributed the fall in profit to a slump in PVC prices which hit the chemicals division and a bad performance from the sanitary division. The closure of the unprofitable assembly works also hit profits via a 550 million peseta tax.
The company said building work had improved in October and building activity was much higher than in the same month of 1995.
Uralita said the company's debt had fallen in the third quarter and by the end of September it stood at 12.2 billion pesetas, despite its program of heavy investment to increase productive capacity.
The company said it would recommend the payment of a dividend in December at its meeting in November, although it did not specify the amount.
